prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
(none yet)

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
(not available)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 77.0%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 87.7%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 20.3%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Pet Controls & Interaction Walkthrough Screen: Adds a dedicated onboarding step before completion that demonstrates how to click, summon, hide, and speak to the desktop pet. (why: Support received 3 emails from users confused about pet controls after setup, and finish step conversion is only 64.8%.)
1: [finish, notification] Desktop System Tray Pinning Prompt: Adds a notification callout on the final screen showing users how to pin and locate the pet mascot icon in the system tray. (why: Finish stage drop-off is 35.2% and support received queries regarding hidden or un-openable pets.)
2: [sign_in, copy] Existing Account Pet Data Sync Clarification: Clarifies sign-in headline and body text to reassure returning users that signing in restores existing pets. (why: 8 support emails complained about missing or reset pets after signing in.)

scores.note: Adding an extra screen introduces step friction, and evidence from support is minimal (3 emails).
Addresses high drop-off at finish screen via notification without adding a new full screen.
Strong alignment with 8 support complaints; zero-friction copy change is cheap and highly effective.
